title.en: From here it can happen any day
title.hi: Yahan se kabhi bhi ho sakta hai

body.en: Full term is close. Keep your phone charged and loud, tell work, and stop making plans you cannot leave. Readiness is mostly logistics.
body.hi: Full term kareeb hai. Phone charge aur awaaz par rakhiye, kaam par bata dijiye, aur aise plans banana band kijiye jinhe chhod na sakein. Taiyaari zyadatar intezaam hi hai.
